digest.component_or_area: Ruff linting configuration and timezone validation
propositions: Ruff ASYNC and DTZ rule families must be enabled in the global configuration and pass zero-diagnostic gate across src/rebar and tests directories.
Timestamp validation in validate_checks.py must use explicit UTC timezone semantics: epoch seconds via datetime.timezone.utc and timezone-less persisted strings assigned UTC before clustering.

Security pin cadence detection must obtain an aware current instant with explicit timezone, convert to host-local timezone, and extract date to preserve calendar-date semantics while satisfying DTZ005.
Six existing ASYNC/DTZ diagnostics (DTZ006, DTZ007, DTZ011 in src; DTZ001, ASYNC110, ASYNC251 in tests) must be resolved before the ratchet is enabled.
The literal datetime.UTC token must be prohibited from production Python under src/rebar; only datetime.timezone.utc is permitted for py310 target.
Timezone invariance must be proven by validation behavior producing identical UTC hour cluster keys under at least two distinct TZ environment values on POSIX/macOS platforms.
